speaker: provider

text.en: Take the malaria tablets every day for all 14 days, even when you feel well.
text.th: กินยามาลาเรียทุกวันให้ครบ 14 วัน แม้จะรู้สึกดีขึ้นแล้ว

source.note: Written 2026-10-13 from the disease-burden report. English and Thai are unreviewed drafts by the scaffold author.

notes: P. vivax is about 90 percent of Thai cases; relapse prevention depends on completing primaquine. Dose itself is never in a phrase. This record is skipped at build until Burmese or Mon reaches status 'human'.
